components.description:
One or more components of generated data. Final timeseries is basically a vector sum of all of it's components.
If any of the parameter in individual specs is not specified it will be picked randomly from 0..1 range.

possibleValues.description: List of possible values. If specified then components param is ignored.

unit.description: Unit id for ts data point.

carbon.description: Carbon code that generates timeseries data. If specified then the rest of the parameters are ignored.

title:
